data.title: Add docket edit command
data.body:
## Goal

Add a `docket edit ID` command that opens the bug body in `$EDITOR` for editing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket edit ID` opens the current bug body in the user's `$EDITOR`
- [ ] On save and close, the updated body is saved via an `Updated` event
- [ ] If `$EDITOR` is not set, fall back to `vi` or show helpful error
- [ ] Support prefix ID matching like other commands
- [ ] Handle editor exit without changes (no event emitted)

## Context

Currently updating a bug body requires a clunky workflow:
```bash
docket show abc1 > /tmp/bug.md
$EDITOR /tmp/bug.md
docket update abc1 --body /tmp/bug.md
```

This is the biggest UX friction point. Should be a single command.
